meaning: The comment justifies giving Rspine₊q its own panel, separate from the outflow panel, on the grounds that it is an internal craniospinal redistribution rather than a drainage route. It backs this with cited magnitudes (±0.98 mL/s non-pulsatile, -4.2..57.9 pulsatile for p083, vs outflows ~0.005), which are the stated reason a shared or twin axis is rejected.

could_move.what: The quoted magnitudes are from p083 only; if another patient deck has smaller Rspine₊q or larger outflows, the scale argument for a separate panel weakens.
Panel layout and axis choice for every deck that renders this group changes with the decision, e.g. the p081 and p137 jugular compression decks.

The sibling claim that brain₊ext₊q is -(Rspine₊q + shunt₊q) is asserted in the same comment block and is what makes the single-element choice correct; if the model equation differs, the panel content is mislabelled.

expectation: Unknown. The numbers cannot be confirmed from the context given, and the reach trace found no references to this site, so I cannot tell which decks actually draw this panel or whether the p083 numbers still hold.

check.why: Replots the p083 deck named in the comment without re-fitting, so the separated Rspine panel and its axis range can be compared against the quoted ±0.98 and -4.2..57.9 values.
